name: @swasthyasetu/mobile
comment: DELIBERATELY NOT AN npm WORKSPACE. React Native is exquisitely sensitive to duplicated copies of react and react-native, and workspace hoisting produces exactly that. This package installs its own node_modules and pulls the two shared packages in over `file:` links, which npm materialises as symlinks that Metro follows (see metro.config.js). Install with `npm install --prefix apps/mobile`; run with `npm run dev:mobile` from the repo root.
comment2: The only network dependency is the SwasthyaSetu API. There is no LLM SDK, no analytics, no crash reporter and no map tile key here, and scripts/check-no-secrets.mjs fails the build if a credential ever appears in this directory.
